沒信心與同學用英語進行課程討論嗎？

希望能無痛掌握全英課堂的內容重點與互動方式嗎？

快來參加專業英語午餐小聚！

我們將用不同主題，包含教育學習，商業行銷與科學科技，透過國際生們的引導，讓您了解主題內容與關鍵字彙，還可以練習小組討論與發表喔！

★活動免費｜No charge
★名額有限｜Limited seats
★手刀報名｜Sign up now

Are you lacking confidence in discussing course topics in English with your classmates? 

Do you wish to effortlessly grasp the key points and interact in an English-taught classroom? 

Come join our English for Specific Purposes Lunch Gathering! 

We will cover various topics, including business, history, science and technology, guided by international students. You'll gain insights into the topics and key vocabulary, while also practicing group discussions and presentations!

Registration is free, but seats are limited. 

Register now!

Come join our English for Specific Purposes Lunch Gathering! 

We will cover various topics, including business, history, science and technology, guided by international students. You'll gain insights into the topics and key vocabulary, while also practicing group discussions and presentations!

【Session 2】
Science × History: The Cutting Edge of TSMC
領先鋒，台積電

Date: April 30
Time: 12:10 PM - 1:00 PM
Description: This event explores Taiwan's semiconductor industry, focusing on TSMC. We will briefly look into TSMC's history and strategic development, Taiwan's role in the global chip supply chain, and covers a short analysis of relevant data. You will learn useful vocabulary and how to read charts and graphs.
